question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Nectar in a Sieve'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamala Markandaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Kamala Markandaya** is the author of the book 'Nectar in a Sieve'.
 
• 'Nectar in a Sieve' was her first published novel, released in **1954**.
 
• The novel is set in India and deals with the hardships faced by a rural family.
 
• It was critically acclaimed and became a bestseller, highlighting Kamala Markandaya's literary prowess.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamala Markandaya**

 
 
• Born in 1924 in Mysore, India, Kamala Markandaya was an eminent Indian novelist and journalist.
 
• Her real name was Kamala Purnaiya Taylor, and she was one of the first Indian women to gain international recognition for her literary works.
 
• She moved to Britain in 1948 and spent much of her adult life there, though her novels often focused on Indian themes and settings.
 
 
 
• **Themes in 'Nectar in a Sieve'**
 
 
• The novel addresses themes such as poverty, resilience, and the impact of industrialization on rural India.
 
• It also explores the struggles and perseverance of its protagonist, Rukmani, and her family.
 
 
 
• **Literary Style**
 
 
• Kamala Markandaya is known for her evocative and lyrical prose, which vividly portrays the socio-economic conditions of her characters.
 
• Her narrative style often includes a blend of traditional Indian storytelling and modern literary techniques.
 
 
 
• **Other Works by Kamala Markandaya**
 
 
• Some of her other notable works include 'Some Inner Fury' (1955), 'A Silence of Desire' (1960), and 'Possession' (1963).
 
• Her novels frequently dealt with the clash between tradition and modernity in Indian society.
